title: CAKE: Compiler-Agent Co-Design for Frontier Kernel Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2608.12629v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GPU kernel agents and GPU programming languages have advanced separately, leaving expert kernels difficult to reproduce. Agents usually treat the compiler as a fixed black box and receive only errors, correctness outcomes, and timing, while existing DSLs either hide critical scheduling decisions or expose them through difficult layout abstractions. We present CAKE, a compiler-agent co-design in which agents author CAKE IR, a typed, hardware-explicit schedule representation. CAKE exposes warp roles, memory movement, synchronization, and pipelines while supporting verification, cost modeling, and localized diagnostics. The harness itself evolves: recurring failures become verifier rules, IR primitives, model calibrations, and reusable optimization tactics. In matched implementation-hidden Flash-KMeans clean starts on B200, the best CAKE IR candidate at an 80-million-token budget runs at 1.144x the tuned FlashML baseline, compared with 0.92

translated_title: CAKE：编译器与智能体协同设计，推动前沿内核演进
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12629v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：GPU内核智能体和GPU编程语言各自独立发展，使得专家级内核难以复现。智能体通常将编译器视为固定的黑盒，仅接收错误、正确性结果和计时信息，而现有的领域特定语言（DSL）要么隐藏关键调度决策，要么通过困难的布局抽象来暴露它们。我们提出CAKE，一种编译器-智能体协同设计，其中智能体编写CAKE IR，这是一种类型化、硬件显式的调度表示。CAKE暴露了线程束角色、内存移动、同步和流水线，同时支持验证、成本建模和局部诊断。该框架本身也在演进：反复出现的失败会转化为验证器规则、IR原语、模型校准和可复用的优化策略。在匹配实现隐藏的Flash-KMeans全新启动于B200上的测试中，最佳CAKE IR候选在8000万token预算下运行速度为调优后的FlashML基线的1.144倍，而基线为0.92。
tldr: CAKE通过协同设计编译器与智能体，引入类型化、硬件显式的IR，使智能体能直接控制调度细节，并在B200上实现超越调优基线的性能提升。
en_tdlr: CAKE co-designs compiler and agent with a typed, hardware-explicit IR, enabling agents to control scheduling directly and achieving superior performance over tuned baselines on B200.
